conditions: Clean reference, direct index selection; no noise, quantisation or bit errors.
anti_alias_filter: Intentionally bypassed to expose folding; not the recommendation for a general sampler.
reconstruction: Same R1.2 periodic Fourier interpolation for both paths; only low-rate samples enter recovery.
evaluation: All original grid positions; no trimming, fitted gain, time shift or original-tone-assisted recovery.
prediction_only: Source parameters explain the expected folds and error power after sampling; they are never passed to the recovery function.
